_comment: Claude Code hook configuration for aimem. Copy to ~/.claude/settings.json or merge into your existing settings. All hooks run with AIMEM_CALLER_ROLE=hook (untrusted layer).

hooks.command: AIMEM_CALLER_ROLE=hook aimem query --json "project goals and constraints" --top-k 5 2>/dev/null || true
AIMEM_CALLER_ROLE=hook aimem add --type observation --title 'File edited in session' --body "$CLAUDE_TOOL_RESULT" --tag 'claude-code' --tag 'auto' 2>/dev/null || true
